DGI.type: publisher composite index, not calibrated route score
DGI.referencePeriod: 2025 DGI: 2023-01-01 through 2024-12-31, except Indonesia and Thailand: 2022-01-01 through 2023-12-31
DGI.edition: 2025 DGI reported in OECD 2026 outlook; includes comparator 2023 edition

GovTech.type: publisher composite indices plus unrescaled coded survey/remote-review responses
GovTech.unit: indices 0–1; other fields use item-specific codes, years, names or URLs
GovTech.edition: December 2025 workbook; survey March–June 2025, validation July–October 2025
GovTech.coverageReconciliation: 198 country-code rows including Nicaragua placeholder with hyphens; 197 assessed economies. All 33 target countries plus US have rows.
GovTech.sourceMethod: 158 participating economies surveyed; 39 remotely collected. Workbook reports use of generative AI for validation and remote collection; not independent audited operational efficacy.

BREADY.type: expert answers (including binary regulatory provisions and durations), not transaction events
BREADY.durationUnit: calendar days except MCP_29_3 labelled days
BREADY.numericRule: Only plain numeric strings copied into numeric_days; annotations and Skip Logic retained without conversion
BREADY.dates: Publication edition established; specific item collection dates not included in extracted answer rows

EnterpriseSurveys.edition: Latest published economy wave in API at retrieval; year retained per row
EnterpriseSurveys.type: published aggregate survey indicators; not microdata
EnterpriseSurveys.bready_reg9: Average days to receive payment under government contract; current API code differs from older reg9
EnterpriseSurveys.limits: API definition field returns placeholder text for some indicators; detailed denominator/SE/sample counts not returned by these endpoints. Twelve regulation indicators and one tender-difficulty index retained.
EnterpriseSurveys.missing: n.a. is missing, never zero. UAE absent from inspected latest-economy API; this is not a claim no UAE surveys exist.

Inventories.type: source-row extracts with country alias matching, no population weights
Inventories.PSTW: All technology/status rows retained for targets, not solely operational AI
Inventories.Epoch: Published inventory includes planned/existing and revisions; no deduplication or global-capacity denominator imposed
Inventories.aliases: retrieve.py ALIASES; US retained only as a separately labelled comparator

OCDS.award_date: awards.date for award linked through contract.awardID
OCDS.release_date: compiled release update timestamp, not event occurrence
OCDS.contractPeriod: scheduled/contractual period, not proof of actual implementation completion
OCDS.dateMet: milestone actual completion field; eight inspected milestones populated, all identical to their dueDate; verify reported actuals against original evidence
OCDS.durationRule: ISO dateSigned minus matching awards.date; negative results flagged; no empirical probability inferred
